reviewScope: Static and media scene producer lifecycles, private content texture ownership, video source publication, audio raster caching and dynamic overlays, media measurement boundaries.
reviewContext: Independent clean context. Product source is read-only. No shared dist build, user board mutation, actual asset-body access or browser/native process started during the executor's exclusive timing window.

requirements.result: Source inspection and final numerical records confirm stable publisher/producer lifetime through ordinary view/camera movement. Both final full runs recorded zero producer identity events and zero static-image re-publications during playback phases. Video source work changed from producer HTMLCanvasElement to direct native HTMLVideoElement; source dimensions remain intact.
requirements.remaining: None within measured owned source lifecycle scope.

requirements.result: Independent Node mock plus actual Chromium 155.0.8059.39 numbered H264 baseline video passed five immediate-readiness seek repetitions without grace, forward/backward seeks, frame-number-to-PTS equality during playback, pause, native loop, source replacement, and a real retained RVFC delivered after a newer seek generation. Prior captured PNG channels stayed equal. Browser errors were empty.
requirements.remaining: Actual user asset codec/duration remain outside inspected scope.

requirements.result: Independent real Chromium Canvas passed synchronous private command/image/Path2D pixel ownership after source, command and metadata mutation; N+1 changed while N stayed exact. Done evidence copied N synchronously and PNG channels plus media/frameSeq stayed N after N+1. Twelve forbidden/nonfinite/invalid command cases threw TypeError without invoking callbacks. Forged texture shape was rejected before callback. Pixel and command tainted image sources threw SecurityError; actual visible N+1 pixels and frameSeq remained unchanged after failures. Generic SceneFrame retained copied pixels. Destination canvas/context stayed private and metadata deeply frozen.
requirements.remaining: None within owned isolated Chromium/Canvas functional scope.

requirements.result: Sixteen independent actual AudioCanvasPlayer cases matched uncached same-GPU complete panel rendering with zero changed channels: loading, ready, disabled, hidden dynamic canvas, controlled title-to-clock selection, theme, stack, ancestor opacity, font, tiny-cover load, ordinary 256x256 cover, waveform-only decode error with native audio ready, native media error, second-change pause transition terminal, native seek 2.5s, keyboard focus. Each current default CPU helper result also matched a separately loaded git f3269b8 CPU helper exactly. Browser errors were empty.
requirements.remaining: Performance remains pending. GPU and historical CPU raster pixels differ; backend quality assessment is explicitly separate.

requirements.result: Independent unpacking and recomputation passed all four final raw archives. Full runs use identical object IDs/kinds/bounds, fixture directory, browser and DPR. Baseline 2508 native inputs are covered by 2470 matched first geometry commits and 38 later-input supersessions; candidate 2508 inputs all match. All 21 input phases retain zero pending input and matched terminal input. Each pair matches actual frameSeq/time/camera/objectXY/media and all three latest native surface publications; reported P50/P95/max exactly match raw latencies. Every input phase has real HTML activity. Native PCM and RVFC/decoded frames remain real, separate singlePlayback trials. The two loading-only repetitions intentionally have no gesture trials.
requirements.remaining: None for the accuracy of current scoped measurement claims. Native warm/cache-cleared startup variation and F2 smooth-scroll pairing remain explicit limits below.

retainedInitialEvidence.executorFailures: loading-playback-execution.json retains the initial instrumentation zero-match, background oracle, pause-transition and fixture-range failures with explicit boundaries. No failed or skipped run is accepted as a pass.
retainedInitialEvidence.numericBoundary: Performance remains pending. A private build snapshot is the measured candidate; later source changes need separate functional verification and must not be represented as the same measured snapshot.

independentBrowserInitial.boundary: Real isolated production component and Canvas. Uncached full-panel rendering is the oracle; DOM selection and visibility are controlled internal composition cases.

independentIntermediateNumeric.result: Same browser, DPR, fixture directory and object identity/bounds. Candidate input phases all matched; baseline compact-audio zoom phases retain 4 and 5 superseded inputs. All three HTML sources continued publishing. Each audio phase had one active native media element and nonzero PCM in every active sample. Every declared RVFC publication paired with a recorded native callback; video dimensions remained 1920x1080. No concurrent audio-plus-video claim. Warm reload regressed and remains included.
independentIntermediateNumeric.definitions: First image published after private copy and all-images-visible are navigation-relative milestones, not individual copy CPU duration. HTML preparing registry content is excluded from authoritative surface readiness. Successful commit eligibility follows the last authoritative publication; initial detail lacks layer surface refs for exact post hoc pairing.
independentIntermediateNumeric.remaining: Final corrected merged-source numeric repeats and per-input/frame identity data if added.

backendQualityAssessment.method: Independent original f3269b8 CPU helper loaded from git, current default CPU helper, and uncached GPU full-panel renderer were compared separately on the exact private snapshot. GPU reference directly paints the complete current DOM with ordinary native Canvas calls; it does not use compiled commands. Source diff retains default CPU traversal and adds the explicit GPU option.
backendQualityAssessment.findings: Same-GPU complete rendering and cached commands were pixel exact in all 16 cases. Current default CPU helper was pixel exact to original f3269b8 in all 16 cases. GPU versus CPU pixels differ at text/icon antialiasing and image interpolation. Ready and monospace text retained layout, sizes, solid colors and controls. The enlarged 2x2 texture has smooth GPU interpolation and visible CPU color bands with the same endpoint colors and clipping. The ordinary 256x256 texture retained the same 16x16 tile grid, 356x356 bitmap bounds and rounded clipping; 256 tile-center RGB samples differed by at most 1, and source blue values 40/220 were retained. No displaced geometry, opacity error, missing detail or reduced bitmap dimension was observed.
backendQualityAssessment.limits: Old CPU bitmap equality is not claimed. This is owned synthetic source visual inspection, not inspection of user media bodies.

independentOwnershipCommandsFinal.retainedOracleFailure: The intermediate test incorrectly compared a transparent content frame with the actual scene including a white background. Failure and facts are retained; final test compares the real visible canvas before and after failures.

checks.markAtomicPresentation: Mark refresh now runs only after successful Canvas presentation and layout commit; stationary deletion/overlap/pan/reverse-pan/resize and existing hover/click ownership independently passed.
checks.audioSeeking: Native seeking publishes current waveform pixels and matching playback-sampled currentTime metadata before seeked. Original production captured >=.2 assertion and independent in-seeking 2.5 publication passed; no capture-time metadata backfill is used.
checks.annotationFocus: Initial RAF focus preserves a currently focused control inside the active annotation-full. Original two-Arrow .2 test and close/replace editor focus independently passed.

finalNumericAudit.quantileDefinition: p50 index=floor((n-1)*.5), p95 index=ceil((n-1)*.95); all latency samples independently derived as commitAt minus inputAt.
finalNumericAudit.endpoint: Successful main-thread visible Canvas commit; OS compositor/display output is outside scope.
finalNumericAudit.loadingInterpretation: First publication/visibility milestones are navigation-relative, while work.milliseconds measures constructor execution. Cold first-image constructor work did not improve (17/18.3 ms baseline versus 19/18.8 ms candidate). Five-image visible milestones improved in both repetitions. Warm r2 authoritative HTML visible regressed 2384.6 to 3213.3 ms; session-waveform-cache-cleared authoritative HTML visible regressed 2539.4/2343 to 3236/3467 ms. CEF startup tail is retained and independently attributed outside media scope. Asset HTTP is private,no-store; the third reload clears only the session waveform cache, not a claimed warm asset HTTP cache.
finalNumericAudit.sourceWork: Six-second video stationary total drawImage time fell 2800.1 to 142.9 ms and CDP TaskDuration 4766.7 to 1835.2 ms. Total readback time increased 254.6 to 594.4 ms; 1920x1080 origin-readback count changed 362 to 186. Per-frame origin validation remains.
finalNumericAudit.playback: Native video decoded 185 frames in 6.1799s (29.94fps) versus 184 in 6.1753s (29.80fps). All declared RVFC source PTS match native callbacks and all video publications retain 1920x1080. Each audio layout has one active native media element and real nonzero PCM. Baseline tall-audio startup has 318/334 nonzero samples, candidate 369/369. Two brief paused-audio PCM buffer-drain samples at candidate video-phase start are preserved; they are not simultaneous playing-media evidence.
finalNumericAudit.memory: Owned Chrome plus CEF sampled peak RSS is 3789.8 versus 3579.5 MiB. Both remain high; one full run is insufficient to claim a general memory reduction.

currentScopeLimits: The explicit delivery scope is media lifecycle, style preservation and measured interaction performance. F2 native programmatic root smooth-scroll semantic/pixel pairing remains a documented limitation and is not expanded into a CEF-core feature in this delivery.
Warm and session-waveform-cache-cleared native HTML startup tail regressions are retained; general all-loading improvement is not claimed.
Performance measures main-thread successful Canvas commit, not OS compositor or screen output.
Original CPU and candidate GPU pixels retain antialiasing/filter differences. Same-GPU uncached references are pixel exact; original CPU-helper behavior is preserved.

Actual user media codec, duration and decoded dimensions remain unknown. Synthetic source dimensions and rates are retained; MP4 freebox padding matches file bytes rather than original decoder work or actual Range-transfer equivalence.
No simultaneous audio-plus-video performance claim; the product singlePlayback policy is preserved.
